notes.title: 📢 Harvest Scream Demo – Update Notes 📢
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 👋
We’ve released a new update to make Harvest Scream clearer and more enjoyable. Here’s what’s new:

✨ Update Notes
[olist]
🐝 Game economy has been balanced regarding honey production from Beehives.

🌙 Nighttime duration has been extended so anomalies can be found more easily.

⏰ Wake-up time during the day has been adjusted to 6 AM.

📜 A new quest has been added to the first-day quest system:

Previously, anomalies spawned before players obtained the plush toy, which caused confusion and panic.

With the new quest, players now have more time to adapt to the game.

Quests have also been made clearer, leading to a more informative tutorial experience.
[/olist]
Don’t forget to share your feedback, and have fun playing! 🎮💫
